description: This file defines the TimesheetItemDecorator class, which provides methods to decorate and manipulate TimesheetItem entities by setting related entities and formatting date properties within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: TimesheetItemDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for TimesheetItem entity, facilitating setting related entities by ID and formatting date properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a TimesheetItem instance.

methods.name: getTimesheetItem
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the encapsulated TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Sets the associated Project entity on the TimesheetItem by project ID.

methods.name: setProjectActivityById
methods.description: Sets the associated ProjectActivity entity on the TimesheetItem by activity ID.

methods.name: setTimesheetById
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with the TimesheetItem by timesheet ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity on the TimesheetItem based on employee number.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the timesheet item as a string.
